correctness.rationale: The affine cylinders are strictly separated; unrestricted dimension follows by finite similarity approximation and cylinder covers. For nonrepeating words the positive vector v_i=(lambda+r_i^s)^-1 solves the infinite weighted adjacency equation exactly, gives an exponential covering bound above the root, and finite irreducible graph-directed subsets prove the lower bound. Uniform zeta and derivative expansions for s=1-o(q-1), plus the mean value theorem at both pressure roots, show 1-t~(q-1)eta and t-d~(q-1)zeta(2q)/zeta(q)^2. The actual bundled checker verifies the finite eigenvector identity exactly and provides separate nonproof numerical diagnostics.

value.rationale: A nearest-neighbor no-repeat rule is the canonical nontrivial restriction on branch itineraries. In the singular high-entropy Zipf regime its exact Hausdorff-dimension penalty is universally zeta(2)(q-1)^3, independently of every vanishing geometric gap profile, whereas the unrestricted deficit is (q-1)eta. The comparison reveals the sharp natural crossover at gap mass proportional to the digit collision probability and gives a structural benchmark beyond mere numerical dimension computation.
